title: Tafkhim and tarqiq: heavy and light raa in Ya-Sin: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y10 lesson 24 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Tafkhim and tarqiq rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 24. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

head: Case
Raa
Example
rows: Vowel before is fathah or dammah
At a stop after a yaa sakinah

keywords.def: the letter ر, heavy or light by its vowel

questions.q: Decide the raa in «سَابِقُ ٱلنَّهَارِ» (36:40) when joined and when stopping.
questions.a: Joined: ٱلنَّهَارِ has kasrah: light. At a stop: raa sakinah after alif after fathah: heavy.

questions.q: Raa sort (pupil PDF): label every raa in 36:33 to 40 heavy or light, joined and at the stop. Today's rota group recites 36:37 to 40.
Extend: find a light raa sakinah after kasrah in a surah you know.
Stretch: why is the raa in «فِرْقٍۢ» (26:63) heavy even after a kasrah?
questions.a: A heavy letter (ق) follows it in the same word.

questions.q: «قَدَّرْنَٰهُ» (36:39): the raa has a sukoon after a fathah, so it is ...
questions.a: A) heavy. Raa sakinah after fathah: heavy.

questions.q: Think again: The raa changes like the laam of Allah. What do you think decides whether it is heavy or light?
questions.a: Its own vowel, or, if it has a sukoon, the vowel before it.
